transport_type.description: The default transport protocol used by mtp-tools. Valid values are 'usb' or 'tcp'.

tcp_port.description: The TCP port number used when transport_type is set to 'tcp'. Default is 3498.

connection_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for connecting to an MTP device.

verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose debug output for mtp-tools commands.

excluded_vendor_ids.description: List of USB Vendor IDs to exclude from automatic device detection. Format: integer values in decimal or hex (e.g., 0x04e8 or 1256). Items are integers.
